name.en-US: Letters of Blessed John of Avila
name.pt-BR: Cartas do Beato João de Ávila (inglês, 1904)

description.en-US: Twenty-five letters of St. John of Ávila translated by the Benedictines of Stanbrook Abbey (London, Burns & Oates, 1904), among them those to St. Teresa, to Guzmán and Loarte, and to the Jesuit Antonio de Córdoba, each with the translators' short headnote. Each letter carries the number it has in the Spanish Epistolario espiritual of this corpus; letters that book lacks are marked with their number in Sala Balust's critical edition (BAC 1952) or as unidentified.
description.pt-BR: Vinte e cinco cartas de São João de Ávila traduzidas pelas Beneditinas de Stanbrook (1904).

sources.edition: Letters of Blessed John of Avila, translated by the Benedictines of Stanbrook, London: Burns & Oates, 1904 (2 vols. in 1); archive.org scan, OCR. Cross-checked with archive.org lettersofblessed00johnuoft.
sources.description: All 25 letters with the translators' headnotes and footnotes; the preface is not included. OCR not proofread. The correspondence with the Spanish letters was made by comparing subjects, not word by word.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1904; the scan is marked as not in copyright.
